query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:39:00) same, I'll probably head direct. I've got a supervision call until 6 anyway so I'd barely make the food
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:37:00) thai works for me lol. dev you coming for the food or just the stars
[4] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[5] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t1 @2026-02-06T20:18:00) @all new moon is Feb 17th and the week around it looks really promising!!! I'm putting together a Cecilia's Big Nebula Night pitch 🌟 we deserve a proper session after January kept letting us down!!!
[6] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t4 @2026-03-06T20:07:00) 65 miles is a big ask on a Friday night, accessibility matters if we want everyone to come. Blackmoor is 40 mins and people actually show up!!! I love a dark site but we already have good turn-outs at Blackmoor 🌟
[7] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:32:00) ok ok I hear you both, maybe we do need to do one proper dark-sky trip this summer. I'll organise it!!! Two-hour drive is doable if we make a weekend of it and get accommodation 🌟✨
[8] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:33:00) i'm in for a weekend trip, though for planets i still don't need bortle 2 lol. but i won't say no to a weekend away
[9] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:44:00) @all I'll start looking at accommodation near Kielder for new moon in July!!! Who is definitely in? I need numbers by next Friday for the booking!!! 🌟🌟🌟
[10] (about=Ruth, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:31:00) September 22nd works. Hill site, of course. I have a new double-star programme that requires the darker background, specifically the faint companions in Sigma Orionis which I have never successfully split from town.
[11] (about=Cecilia, core, t8 @2026-05-08T20:16:00) Cecilia agreed to organise a proper dark-sky weekend trip this summer, suggesting a two-hour drive with accommodation.
[12] (about=Cecilia, core, t14 @2026-08-07T20:11:00) Cecilia came to a public star party three years ago expecting to be bored and left having signed up for the next session; she is organising the annual dark-sky weekend again for next October and wants Harriet to record the whole event for the podcast.
[13] (about=Harriet, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:40:00) I want to do an episode built around that weekend. The group, the dark sky, the contrast between people seeing it for the first time and veterans like Nadia who have been chasing this for thirty years. Dev, your reaction on the night would be perfect audio.
[14] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:38:00) dev and I stayed up till 3am watching jupiter and saturn transit. the seeing came up to 4/5 around 1am and at 400x on jupiter you could see three festoons in the NEB simultaneously. that's the best planetary night I've had in two years
[15] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:31:00) I have been saying this since session one. In my experience there is no substitute for genuine darkness. The Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0 or above. You cannot replicate it closer to town, full stop.
[16] (about=Ruth, said_by=Harriet, profile, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Harriet noted Ruth said on Saturday night that she had been recommending books about dark skies for years but had never actually experienced one; Harriet wants to use it as the episode's opening line.
[17] (about=Ruth, core, t4 @2026-03-06T19:49:00) Ruth proposes a compromise of one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining the default.
